reply_text:
I didn't find any dated AI predictions from Jensen Huang in 2020, so I've marked it a quiet year. I used 11 of 12 searches and all 6 page openings.

- **Fixed searches:** all three ran exactly once. They brought back only news from 2025–2026. My first search hit a code error while printing the results, so I read the results already returned instead of running it again.
- **Arm deal, 13 September 2020:** this was the main occasion I could find. Nvidia's press release quotes Huang saying "In the years ahead, trillions of computers running AI will create a new internet-of-things that is thousands of times larger than today's internet-of-people." His letter to employees that day uses "Someday" instead. Neither gives a date or a length of time, and neither is about when AGI arrives, so neither qualifies, not even as undated.
- **GTC keynotes, May and October 2020:** I saw these only in news coverage, not in a transcript. Analytics India Magazine lists quotes from that year's GTC keynote, though its 10 September date doesn't match the October GTC. One quote is "the next 20 would seem nothing short of science fiction," but it is about graphics hardware, not AI. Another, "in a couple of 2-3 years, Nvidia GPU will represent 90%…", is a business forecast. The rest say "someday." So nothing qualifies.
- **Another year:** Time's interview with "over the next 10 years, we're going to see the automation of automation" turned out to be from 18 April 2021. It goes under other years.
- **Not checked:** I didn't open the May 2020 VentureBeat column where Huang was asked whether the metaverse would come soon, or any GTC China talk from that year.
